members.name: Gerald Revocatus
members.title: CEO and Co-Founder
members.description:
Gerald Revocatus Mukama - Techpreneur | Founder & CEO of Fiqra Technologies & Fiqra Academy

I am Gerald Revocatus Mukama, a passionate tech entrepreneur focused on empowering Africa’s next generation through technology and innovation. As the Founder and CEO of Fiqra Technologies and Fiqra Academy, I lead both organizations in advancing EdTech and digital transformation across the continent, creating scalable solutions to address social challenges.

With expertise in product management, web development, and digital marketing, I have developed cutting-edge technologies that enhance access to quality education, particularly in underserved communities. Additionally, I lead VijanaTech, where I am responsible for the company’s strategic direction, growth, and organizational culture. My previous projects include overseeing the development of the Tanzania Emerging Youth Awards website and voting system, as well as designing a database for Digital Opportunity Trust (Tanzania), ensuring alignment with each organization’s strategic goals.

I have been honored with several awards, including:
1. Innovation Award – Tanzania Emerging Youth Awards (2021)
2. Top 10 Startups of the Year – The Entrepreneur Africa Awards (2021)
3. National Changemaker – We Make Change Now (2019)
4. Best Newcomer Award Nominee – Global Startups Awards (2023)

I’ve also had the privilege of participating in fellowships and programs such as the Mastercard EdTech Fellowship, Vodacom Digital Accelerator, Africode Mentorship, and the Africave Fellowship. I hold a Certificate in Information Technology and have completed the 'Power and Influence for Positive Impact' program at Harvard Business School. Additionally, I was a finalist for the QS-Wharton Reimagine Education E-Learning Award.

My commitment to driving positive change in Africa’s tech ecosystem is unwavering, and I remain dedicated to fostering digital careers, promoting education, and leveraging technology to empower youth across the continent.

While I am familiar with languages such as C#, C++, Python, and Golang, I thrive in fast-paced environments and quickly adapt to new languages and technologies.

I've successfully developed cross-platform native mobile apps using SwiftUI, Dart (Flutter), and Kotlin (KMM - Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile). My experience extends to developing APIs for seamless integration with third-party systems, as well as deploying applications on cloud servers using Docker.

In addition to my technical skills, I possess strong interpersonal, communication, and time management abilities, which enable me to thrive in team environments and meet project deadlines effectively. I'm a fast learner and capable of handling multiple projects concurrently.

members.name: Lusekelo Mwakipiti
members.title: Design Lead
members.description:
I am Lusekelo Rex Mwakipiti, a dedicated professional with a Diploma in Legal Studies from the International University of Kampala and a Bachelor's degree in International Relations and Diplomacy from the Salim Ahmed Salim Centre for Foreign Relations in Dar es Salaam. My career uniquely combines strategic insight with creative design.

In my current roles as a Graphic Designer at Fiqra Technologies and a Seasonal Designer at Zanchangemakers, I focus on crafting innovative visual solutions that enhance user engagement and reinforce brand identity. Additionally, through my freelancing brand, Always Be Creative, I bring over four years of experience in providing high-quality design services across various industries, elevating clients' visual communication and branding efforts.

My involvement in global affairs is highlighted by my participation in the Tanzania International Model United Nations, organized by the Youth of United Nations Association (YUNA) in 2020 and 2021. This experience allowed me to engage with emerging global leaders and contribute to discussions on international policy and global challenges, significantly deepening my understanding of international diplomacy.

During my internship at the International Republican Institute in Tanzania, I assisted in preparing programs for several office events and wrote detailed reports as part of the Program team. This role provided me with valuable project management experience and the opportunity to contribute to initiatives aimed at strengthening democratic institutions and promoting effective governance.

I am passionate about integrating my creative and strategic skills to make a meaningful impact both professionally and globally.
